title: Japanese bed: 38 mm construction
notes: Japanese beds have a Construction choice: 18 mm (inner bands, ledge supports, notched corner) or 38 mm.
38 mm: single heavy rails on the floor (the foot one full width over the sides, none at the head), the top ledge bands lying on them with the foot one full…
Rail, ledge and centre beam thickness can be set (38 mm); nailers and slats keep the panel thickness. The manual shows the butt corner in plan.
notes_es: Las camas japonesas tienen una opción de Construcción: 18 mm (bandas interiores, soportes de repisa, esquina con rebaje) o 38 mm.
